title: Week 3
verification_note: Sunday final-card routine built on DraftKings' own numbers, pulled through The Odds API at 15:02 UTC 2026-09-27 (368 requests remaining this month). Thursday's Falcons-Packers game is now final (Falcons won 35-14) -- both Thursday tickets graded as losses, -$15.00. Nothing on the 16-game Sunday/Monday board clears Rule A (+0.015 combined_edge); every new leg below qualifies under Rule B (own estimate above DK implied, within 6 points of Pinnacle fair, or documented fresh news) and none is below the -0.05 floor. Two new core singles (Browns ML, Seahawks -8.5) and two new cross-game parlays (Steelers ML + Jaguars -3; Cowboys +3 + Dolphins Under 45.5) spend the remaining $50 of Sunday's $70 (the two early tickets already placed $20). No Same Game Parlay this week -- every same-game total on the board is meaningfully negative vs. Pinnacle (several close to the -0.05 floor), so no correlated pair clears even Rule B. Monday (Eagles at Bears) is left for its own build Monday afternoon off Sunday's closing lines, $15 reserved.

tickets.name: Cardinals ML
tickets.why: combined_edge +0.022, best on the 16-game board. Brock Purdy remains out for San Francisco (Mac Jones starts again) while Kyler Murray and the rest of Arizona's offense are fully healthy -- a real, clean health gap. The line already moved 3 points toward Arizona this week (open -11.5 to now -8.5), but the moneyline price hasn't fully caught up, and public money is still piling onto San Francisco (~80% of tickets/handle) even as the number moves the other way -- exactly the profile where the popular side's price gets tighter and the dog's gets shorter as the week goes on.
tickets.kill_switch: If Brock Purdy is upgraded to probable/active at Wednesday or Thursday's practice report, pull this ticket -- SF getting its real starting QB back erases the edge. Also pull if the price shortens past +320.

tickets.name: Packers ML + Under 42.5 SGP
tickets.why: Favorite + under correlation. Green Bay ML (combined_edge -0.020, own estimate 72% vs 71.0% breakeven, Pinnacle fair 69.0%) plus Under 42.5 (combined_edge -0.027, own estimate 52% vs 50.5% breakeven, Pinnacle fair 49.8%) -- if Green Bay wins it's more likely a controlled, lower-scoring game given the O-line attrition and short week than a shootout. Thinnest leg on the card, flagged as such. Naive reference price ~+179; minimum acceptable price +130, else fall back to $2.50/$2.50 straights.
tickets.kill_switch: If Green Bay loses another O-line starter on the 6:45 PM inactives beyond what's priced, drop the ML leg and put the full $5 on Under 42.5 alone. If the total moves to 44.5+ before kickoff, drop the Under leg and take $5 straight on Green Bay ML at -245 or better. If the SGP builder won't clear +130, split into $2.50 on Green Bay ML and $2.50 on Under 42.5.

tickets.name: Cowboys +3 + Dolphins Under 45.5
tickets.game: Ravens at Cowboys / Chiefs at Dolphins
tickets.why: Dog-plus-under read across two games. Cowboys +3 -102 (combined_edge +0.0012): Ravens starting LT Ronnie Stanley (toe) is OUT -- a real protection question for Lamar Jackson in this neutral-site game in Rio de Janeiro. Dolphins Under 45.5 -115: Tua Tagovailoa was placed on IR this week after a concussion; Skylar Thompson (career backup, limited volume) is the confirmed starter, and Kansas City -- an overwhelming public favorite at 94% of spread money -- tends to protect a big lead by running clock rather than piling on garbage-time points. This is the thinnest leg on the card (combined_edge -0.022 on the number alone, a Rule B qualifier on fresh news, not a price edge), flagged rather than hidden. Joint estimate 27.8% vs the +270 breakeven of 27.0%.
tickets.kill_switch: If the Cowboys number moves to +2.5 or worse, or the Dolphins total climbs to 47 or higher, before kickoff, drop that leg and take the other straight at $5.
